item.title: Effort estimation — it’s complicated
item.description:
Effort estimation — it’s complicated

On the dilemma of evaluating software development effort

For the past few months, estimating effort, a long-standing dilemma of the software industry, bothers me. How should we, as SW engineers, deal with the accuracy of effort estimations? The answer is complicated and has implications over developers’ career growth, having an impact on personal development. There is much at stake.

So, I felt the urge to take action. I decided to share my doubts about it over twitter.

item.title: Arrange your time and your mind will follow
item.description:
Being productive by taking control of your time

A gym workout, a reminder to walk the dog, meeting with your colleagues on that project presentation, a dentist appointment — are all on the same page. You can’t separate artificially between your work and personal calendars. Why? Because that’s how your life works. The goal is to see what your actual day looks like, to blend between work and personal life for finding the right balance that fits you.
